tasks.label: mkdir-setup
tasks.command: mkdir cmd\controlplane cmd\proxy internal\config internal\logging internal\policy internal\vault internal\grant internal\events migrations

tasks.label: setup-lanyard-project
tasks.command: cmd /c "mkdir cmd\controlplane cmd\proxy internal\config internal\logging internal\policy internal\vault internal\grant internal\events internal\registry internal\revocation migrations docs\adr .github\workflows && go version"

tasks.label: setup-lanyard-project-2
tasks.command: mkdir "cmd\controlplane" "cmd\proxy" "internal\config" "internal\logging" "internal\policy" "internal\vault" "internal\grant" "internal\events" "internal\registry" "internal\revocation" "migrations" "docs\adr" ".github\workflows"; go version

tasks.label: check-go-toolchain
tasks.command: cmd /c "where go || echo no-go && where.exe go || echo no-go2 && dir"

tasks.label: new-check-go
tasks.command: if (Get-Command go -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { go version } else { Write-Host 'no-go' }; Get-ChildItem

tasks.label: install-go
tasks.command: winget install --id GoLang.Go --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements

tasks.label: check-go-after-install
tasks.command: cmd /c "where go && go version"

tasks.label: list-go-bin
tasks.command: Get-ChildItem 'C:\Program Files\Go\bin'

tasks.label: create-lanyard-layout
tasks.command: $dirs = @('cmd/controlplane','cmd/proxy','internal/config','internal/logging','internal/policy','internal/vault','internal/grant','internal/events','internal/registry','internal/revocation','migrations','docs/adr','.github/workflows'); foreach ($d in $dirs) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $PWD $d) -Force | Out-Null }; Write-Host 'dirs-ready'

tasks.label: go-mod-init
tasks.command: $env:Path += ';C:\Program Files\Go\bin'; Set-Location 'V:\lanyard'; go mod init github.com/example/lanyard

tasks.label: go-test
tasks.command: Set-Location 'V:\lanyard'; & 'C:\Program Files\Go\bin\gofmt.exe' -w 'internal\grant\grant.go' 'internal\grant\service.go' 'internal\grant\service_test.go'; & 'C:\Program Files\Go\bin\go.exe' test ./...

tasks.label: go-build
tasks.command: Set-Location 'V:\lanyard'; & 'C:\Program Files\Go\bin\go.exe' build ./...

tasks.label: research-aws-agent-toolkit-setup
tasks.command: firecrawl --status; if ($?) { firecrawl scrape 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws/refs/heads/main/setup-instructions/setup.md' -o "$env:TEMP\lanyard-aws-agent-toolkit-setup.md" }

tasks.label: check-aws-toolkit-prerequisites
tasks.command: Write-Output "OS=$env:OS"; Write-Output '--- tools ---'; foreach ($name in @('aws','uv','curl')) { $command = Get-Command $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($command) { Write-Output "$name=$($command.Source)" } else { Write-Output "$name=missing" } }; Write-Output '--- AWS CLI endpoint ---'; try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://awscli.amazonaws.com' -Method Head -TimeoutSec 15; Write-Output "HTTP=$([int]$response.StatusCode)" } catch { Write-Output "ERROR=$($_.Exception.Message)" }

tasks.label: probe-awscli-connectivity
tasks.command: $curlCommand = Get-Command curl.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($curlCommand) { Write-Output "curl.exe=$($curlCommand.Source)"; & $curlCommand.Source -I --max-time 15 'https://awscli.amazonaws.com' } else { Write-Output 'curl.exe=missing' }

tasks.label: verify-awscli-download-access
tasks.command: try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://awscli.amazonaws.com' -Method Head -TimeoutSec 15; Write-Output "HTTP=$([int]$response.StatusCode)" } catch { Write-Output "ERROR=$($_.Exception.Message)"; exit 1 }

tasks.label: download-awscli-installer
tasks.command: $installer = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'AWSCLIV2.msi'; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://awscli.amazonaws.com/AWSCLIV2.msi' -OutFile $installer; if ($?) { $item = Get-Item $installer; Write-Output "Downloaded official AWS CLI MSI to $($item.FullName) ($($item.Length) bytes)" }

tasks.label: download-official-awscli-msi
tasks.command: $installer = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'AWSCLIV2.msi'; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://awscli.amazonaws.com/AWSCLIV2.msi' -OutFile $installer; if ($?) { $item = Get-Item $installer; Write-Output ('Downloaded official AWS CLI MSI to {0} ({1} bytes)' -f $item.FullName, $item.Length); Get-FileHash $installer -Algorithm SHA256 }

tasks.label: install-awscli-v2
tasks.command: $installer = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'AWSCLIV2.msi'; $process = Start-Process -FilePath 'msiexec.exe' -ArgumentList @('/i', $installer, '/qn', '/norestart') -Wait -PassThru; Write-Output "InstallerExitCode=$($process.ExitCode)"; if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { exit $process.ExitCode }; $aws = 'C:\Program Files\Amazon\AWSCLIV2\aws.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $aws)) { $aws = 'C:\Program Files\Amazon\AWSCLI\bin\aws.exe' }; if (Test-Path $aws) { & $aws --version } else { Write-Output 'AWS CLI executable not found after installation'; exit 1 }

tasks.label: diagnose-awscli-install-failure
tasks.command: $installer = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'AWSCLIV2.msi'; $log = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'AWSCLIV2-install.log'; $process = Start-Process -FilePath 'msiexec.exe' -ArgumentList @('/i', $installer, '/qn', '/norestart', '/l*v', $log) -Wait -PassThru; Write-Output "InstallerExitCode=$($process.ExitCode)"; if (Test-Path $log) { Select-String -Path $log -Pattern 'Return value 3|error|denied|privilege|another installation|already installed|Product:' -Context 1,2 | Select-Object -Last 25 }

tasks.label: read-awscli-install-troubleshooting
tasks.command: firecrawl scrape 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws/refs/heads/main/setup-instructions/setup-troubleshooting.md' -o "$env:TEMP\lanyard-aws-agent-toolkit-troubleshooting.md"

tasks.label: verify-awscli-msi-signature
tasks.command: $installer = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'AWSCLIV2.msi'; $signature = Get-AuthenticodeSignature $installer; Write-Output "Status=$($signature.Status)"; Write-Output "Signer=$($signature.SignerCertificate.Subject)"; if ($signature.Status -ne 'Valid' -or $signature.SignerCertificate.Subject -notmatch 'Amazon') { throw 'AWS CLI MSI signature verification failed' }

tasks.label: run-signed-awscli-installer
tasks.command: $installer = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'AWSCLIV2.msi'; $process = Start-Process -FilePath 'msiexec.exe' -ArgumentList @('/i', $installer) -Wait -PassThru; Write-Output "InstallerExitCode=$($process.ExitCode)"; if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { exit $process.ExitCode }; $aws = 'C:\Program Files\Amazon\AWSCLIV2\aws.exe'; if (Test-Path $aws) { & $aws --version } else { Write-Output 'Restart the shell or locate aws.exe after successful installation' }

tasks.label: aws-login-laneyard-profile
tasks.command: $aws = 'C:\Program Files\Amazon\AWSCLIV2\aws.exe'; & $aws configure set region ap-southeast-2 --profile laneyard; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & $aws login --region ap-southeast-2 --profile laneyard

tasks.label: verify-laneyard-aws-access
tasks.command: $aws = 'C:\Program Files\Amazon\AWSCLIV2\aws.exe'; & $aws sts get-caller-identity --profile laneyard --query '{Authenticated:Account}' --output json; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

tasks.label: verify-aws-identity-laneyard
tasks.command: $env:AWS_PAGER = ''; $aws = 'C:\Program Files\Amazon\AWSCLIV2\aws.exe'; & $aws sts get-caller-identity --profile laneyard --query '{Authenticated:Account}' --output json; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

tasks.label: verify-sts-laneyard
tasks.command: $aws = 'C:\Program Files\Amazon\AWSCLIV2\aws.exe'; & $aws --no-cli-pager sts get-caller-identity --profile laneyard --query '{Authenticated:Account}' --output json; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

tasks.label: configure-agent-toolkit-laneyard
tasks.command: $aws = 'C:\Program Files\Amazon\AWSCLIV2\aws.exe'; & $aws --no-cli-pager configure agent-toolkit --yes --region us-east-1 --profile laneyard; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

tasks.label: verify-agent-toolkit-laneyard
tasks.command: $aws = 'C:\Program Files\Amazon\AWSCLIV2\aws.exe'; & $aws --no-cli-pager agent-toolkit list-available-skills --region us-east-1 --profile laneyard; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

tasks.label: inspect-aws-mcp-configs
tasks.command: $paths = @('C:\Users\muhai\.claude.json','C:\Users\muhai\.config\devin\mcp_config.json','C:\Users\muhai\.gemini\settings.json','C:\Users\muhai\.kiro\settings\mcp.json','C:\Users\muhai\.config\opencode\opencode.json','C:\Users\muhai\.codeium\mcp_config.json'); foreach ($path in $paths) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path) { try { $root = Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $servers = $root.mcpServers; if ($null -eq $servers) { $servers = $root.servers }; if ($null -eq $servers) { Write-Output ("FILE {0}: no mcpServers/servers section" -f $path); continue }; foreach ($property in $servers.PSObject.Properties) { if ($property.Name -match 'aws') { $envObject = $property.Value.env; $envNames = @(); $profileValue = ''; if ($null -ne $envObject) { $envNames = @($envObject.PSObject.Properties.Name); if ($null -ne $envObject.AWS_MCP_PROXY_PROFILES) { $profileValue = [string]$envObject.AWS_MCP_PROXY_PROFILES } }; Write-Output ("FILE {0} SERVER {1} ENV_KEYS={2} PROFILE={3}" -f $path,$property.Name,($envNames -join ','),$profileValue) } } } catch { Write-Output ("FILE {0}: JSON parse failed ({1})" -f $path,$_.Exception.Message) } } else { Write-Output ("FILE {0}: missing" -f $path) } }

tasks.label: inspect-aws-mcp-configs-retry
tasks.command: $paths = @('C:\Users\muhai\.claude.json','C:\Users\muhai\.config\devin\mcp_config.json','C:\Users\muhai\.gemini\settings.json','C:\Users\muhai\.kiro\settings\mcp.json','C:\Users\muhai\.config\opencode\opencode.json','C:\Users\muhai\.codeium\mcp_config.json'); $results = @(); foreach ($path in $paths) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path) { try { $root = Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $servers = $root.mcpServers; if ($null -eq $servers) { $servers = $root.servers }; if ($null -ne $servers) { foreach ($property in $servers.PSObject.Properties) { if ($property.Name -match 'aws') { $envObject = $property.Value.env; $envNames = @(); $profileValue = ''; if ($null -ne $envObject) { $envNames = @($envObject.PSObject.Properties.Name); if ($null -ne $envObject.AWS_MCP_PROXY_PROFILES) { $profileValue = [string]$envObject.AWS_MCP_PROXY_PROFILES } }; $results += [pscustomobject]@{Path=$path;Server=$property.Name;EnvKeys=($envNames -join ',');Profile=$profileValue} } } } else { $results += [pscustomobject]@{Path=$path;Server='(no server object)';EnvKeys='';Profile=''} } } catch { $results += [pscustomobject]@{Path=$path;Server='(parse error)';EnvKeys='';Profile=''} } } else { $results += [pscustomobject]@{Path=$path;Server='(missing)';EnvKeys='';Profile=''} } }; $results | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4

tasks.label: inspect-opencode-config-shape
tasks.command: $path = 'C:\Users\muhai\.config\opencode\opencode.json'; $root = Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $root.PSObject.Properties | ForEach-Object { $children = ''; if ($null -ne $_.Value -and $null -ne $_.Value.PSObject) { $children = $_.Value.PSObject.Properties.Name -join ',' }; [pscustomobject]@{TopLevel=$_.Name;ChildKeys=$children} } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3

tasks.label: Run Go tests
tasks.command: go

tasks.label: inspect-deploy-readiness-state
tasks.command: git --no-pager status --short; git --no-pager diff --stat; git --no-pager log -1 --oneline

tasks.label: build-lanyard-container
tasks.command: docker build --tag lanyard:ci .

tasks.label: check-firecrawl-and-scrape-aws-setup
tasks.command: firecrawl --status; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; firecrawl scrape 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws/refs/heads/main/setup-instructions/setup.md' -o "$env:TEMP\lanyard-aws-agent-toolkit-setup-retry.md"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Output 'SETUP_GUIDE_SAVED'

tasks.label: verify-aws-profile-and-toolkit-catalog
tasks.command: $aws = 'C:\Program Files\Amazon\AWSCLIV2\aws.exe'; & $aws --no-cli-pager sts get-caller-identity --profile laneyard --query '{Authenticated:Account}' --output json; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $skills = & $aws --no-cli-pager agent-toolkit list-available-skills --region us-east-1 --profile laneyard | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $names = @($skills.skills | ForEach-Object { $_.name }); if ($names.Count -eq 0 -and $skills.data) { $names = @($skills.data | ForEach-Object { $_.name }) }; Write-Output ('AVAILABLE_SKILLS=' + $names.Count); Write-Output ($names -join ', ')

tasks.label: verify-aws-mcp-profile-config
tasks.command: $paths = @('C:\Users\muhai\.claude.json','C:\Users\muhai\.config\devin\mcp_config.json','C:\Users\muhai\.gemini\settings.json','C:\Users\muhai\.kiro\settings\mcp.json','C:\Users\muhai\.config\opencode\opencode.json','C:\Users\muhai\.codeium\mcp_config.json'); foreach ($path in $paths) { $root = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $path | ConvertFrom-Json; $servers = $root.mcpServers; if ($null -eq $servers) { $servers = $root.mcp }; $aws = $servers.'aws-mcp'; $value = $null; if ($null -ne $aws.env) { $value = $aws.env.AWS_MCP_PROXY_PROFILES } elseif ($null -ne $aws.environment) { $value = $aws.environment.AWS_MCP_PROXY_PROFILES }; if ($value -ne 'laneyard') { throw "Unexpected profile setting in $path" }; Write-Output ("OK {0}" -f $path) }

tasks.label: fetch-aws-starter-rules
tasks.command: firecrawl scrape 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws/refs/heads/main/rules/aws-starter-rules.md' -o "$env:TEMP\lanyard-aws-starter-rules.md"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Output 'RULES_SAVED'

tasks.label: verify-toolkit-skills-ap-southeast-2-profile
tasks.command: $env:PYTHONUTF8 = '1'; $env:PYTHONIOENCODING = 'utf-8'; $aws = 'C:\Program Files\Amazon\AWSCLIV2\aws.exe'; & $aws --no-cli-pager agent-toolkit list-available-skills --region us-east-1 --profile laneyard --query skills[].name --output text; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

tasks.label: verify-toolkit-final-config
tasks.command: $aws = 'C:\Program Files\Amazon\AWSCLIV2\aws.exe'; Write-Output ('PROJECT_REGION=' + (& $aws configure get region --profile laneyard)); $paths = @('C:\Users\muhai\.claude.json','C:\Users\muhai\.config\devin\mcp_config.json','C:\Users\muhai\.gemini\settings.json','C:\Users\muhai\.kiro\settings\mcp.json','C:\Users\muhai\.config\opencode\opencode.json','C:\Users\muhai\.codeium\mcp_config.json'); foreach ($path in $paths) { $root = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $path | ConvertFrom-Json; $servers = $root.mcpServers; if ($null -eq $servers) { $servers = $root.mcp }; $awsServer = $servers.'aws-mcp'; $value = $null; if ($null -ne $awsServer.env) { $value = $awsServer.env.AWS_MCP_PROXY_PROFILES } elseif ($null -ne $awsServer.environment) { $value = $awsServer.environment.AWS_MCP_PROXY_PROFILES }; Write-Output ($path + ' AWS_MCP_PROXY_PROFILES=' + $value); if ($value -ne 'laneyard') { exit 2 } }

tasks.label: aws-auth-precheck-session
tasks.command: cmd.exe
